title: Should you buy it? Honest MSFS 2024 marketplace review (Carenado DO228 & SC Designs F-16)
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace developments that represent a monumental shift for deep simulation fidelity and custom environments.

We dive deep into a high-contrasting selection of new arrivals, starting with the supersonic F-16 CDI Fighting Falcon by SC Designs. Boasting thousands of rapid reviews on the storefront, we approach this air superiority fighter with a critical eye—evaluating its native flight behaviors, VR headset compliance, custom cockpit animations, and whether the steep entry price justifies the final product.

Next, we shift focus to a rugged twin-turboprop workhorse making a splash: the legendary DO228 regional utility transport from Carenado. We break down the structural implementation of this high-wing short-field classic, evaluating its complex systems, 15 included historical and modern liveries (including a detailed Dutch Coast Guard variant), custom circuit breaker panels, and its versatile compatibility across the MSFS 2024 Career Mode, VIP charters, and cargo operations.

If you want to breathe completely new life into your everyday turbine or business jet flights, we evaluate a series of tailored flight deck overhauls from Two Pilot. Say goodbye to default styling with custom interior texturing configurations and refined cockpit colorways specifically engineered to update your primary workspace in the TBM 930, Cessna Citation CJ4, and Cessna Citation Longitude.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar!
